name: GJ 338 A
description: A nearby red dwarf, 58% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: radius in solar radii, 0.5773 +/- 0.0131, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: mass 0.622 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: effective temperature in K, 3907 +/- 35, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 58% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.5773 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,907 K.
